title: getFacetValues returns null

comments.body: Hi @ggrlmon, facets are strings not objects. You could facet by `footbalTeams.name` or `footbalTeams.code`, but not using just `footbalTeams`.

Hi @bobylito,

I was more or less expecting to get a confirmation like this, I just hoped there was a way to achieve this.
I got it working with changing the way the objects are structured in algolia.

Something like this:
"footballTeams": [
	"FCB:Barcelona",
	"RMA:Real Madrid",
	"JUV:Torino Juventus"
]

But to be honest I believe this approach is a bit rigid and I can't really think of a better solution right now. I just hoped there was something out of the box that would let me get data back but keeping data in algolia structured in a nice and correct way.

Thank you for your feedback though, really appreciate it

Indeed that's a solution I've suggested in the past. It's rigid, but you master the data so it should be good. On the other hand, it will be weird if you try to use search for facet values and make a search in those facets. Why do you need the code for? Aren't the team names unique?
I need the codes from the facets because we need to call another page that takes the codes as parameters
Not if the product is a international product
